title: Finiteness of a module is equivalent to injectivity of Hom into filtered colimits
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises finiteness of a module N by the injectivity of the map from the filtered colimit of Hom(N, M_i) into Hom(N, M) for every filtered colimit presentation of every module M (statement lines 1805-1813). The proof does not use compactness in an arbitrary category: in one direction it moves the vanishing of each of finitely many generators to some stage and then takes a common later stage, and in the other it applies the hypothesis to the identity map of N and to the filtered colimit of the quotients by submodules generated by finite subsets, concluding that N is generated by one finite subset (proof lines 1815-1831). Deciding to test the hypothesis on the identity map is what produces the finite generating set. H2.
